verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents its own ZeroTrace Mode, under which it does not store search parameters, files, or data once a search completes. Not retaining customer data would in effect keep it out of model training, but this is a retention control rather than an explicit AI-training opt-out or policy. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or contractual commitment that customer data is not used for AI training, documentation of ZeroTrace scope and which plans include it, and independent corroboration.
